# Agent Ledger

> Shared memory for parallel AI coding agents: tasks, decisions, file claims and
> history as plain markdown in git, behind a local hub (127.0.0.1 only). Works
> with any agent that can run a shell command (`ledger` CLI) or call the local
> HTTP API. Local only, no cloud.

## Install

- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md): step-by-step instructions for an AI agent (prerequisites, `./install.sh`, verification, questions to ask the user, uninstall)
- [README.md](README.md): overview, usage, configuration

## Use

- [examples/AGENTS.md.snippet](examples/AGENTS.md.snippet): instructions to paste into a project's `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md`
- [adapters/claude-code/README.md](adapters/claude-code/README.md): optional Claude Code hooks (installed only with consent)

## Develop

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for agents changing this repo
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), [docs/SPEC.md](docs/SPEC.md), [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)

## Optional

- graphify (Python) can be used alongside; `ledger doctor` reports whether it is in PATH. Never installed without the user's consent.
